texts.title: A Vote for a Vote
texts.body: {senator.name} of {senator.house} has a motion before the Senate this session, and has come to count heads. They want your vote. They do not offer money for it. They offer their own: the next time your house moves a motion, {senator.house} will vote for it. In the chamber that is called a fair trade, and both sides remember it. Giving your word casts nothing: the vote is still yours to cast when the Senate sits.

choices.give_your_word: Give your word, and take theirs.
choices.name_a_price: Tell them a vote costs more than a vote.
choices.keep_your_vote: Tell them your vote is your own.

texts.title: A Bought Vote Called In
texts.body: {buyer.name} of {buyer.house} has another motion before the Senate. They paid for your vote once, and they have not forgotten it. They do not mean to pay again. A house that sells its vote once, they say, has told the chamber what it is, and they are sure you would not want the chamber reminded. The vote itself is cast in the chamber, as always.

choices.vote_as_they_ask: Say you will vote for it.
choices.give_back_the_coin: Send back what they paid, and more, and be done with them.
choices.show_them_the_door: Tell them the bargain was for one vote.

texts.title: The Vote Still Undecided
texts.body: Your motion comes to the vote at the end of the session, and {doubter.name} of {doubter.house} has not said which way the house will go. They lean neither for it nor against. In a close count that is the vote that decides it, and a head who thinks well enough of you leans your way.

choices.make_your_case: Go and make your case to them in person.
choices.have_them_to_dinner: Have them to dinner, and talk of anything but the motion.
choices.speak_from_the_floor: Speak for it from the floor, and let them hear it there.
choices.leave_them_be: Leave them to make up their own mind.

texts.title: The Empty Seat on the Bench
texts.body: When the vote was called, your house did not vote. {leader.name} of {leader.house}, who leads your bench, voted, and looked along the bench to see who had not. A house that sits on a bench and will not stand up with it is talked about on the bench before it is talked about anywhere else.

choices.it_was_conscience: Say you could not vote for it, and would not vote against your friends.
choices.say_it_will_not_happen_again: Say it will not happen again.
choices.send_a_gift: Send a gift to their house, and no letter with it.
choices.your_vote_is_your_own: Say your vote is your own to cast or keep.

texts.title: A Feast for the Ayes
texts.body: Your motion carried. The houses that carried it expect to be thanked, and in the Reach that is done at a table. {ally.name} of {ally.house}, who voted with you, has asked whose table it will be.

choices.your_table: Give the dinner yourself, and seat {ally.name} at your right hand.
choices.their_table: Let {ally.name} give it, and go as their guest.

texts.title: Those Who Voted Against You
texts.body: Your motion carried, and {loser.name} of {loser.house} voted against it to the end. They have lost in front of the whole chamber, and they are a house that remembers who it lost to.

choices.offer_them_something: Go to them and offer them something for their trouble.
choices.let_them_lose: Let them lose. It is what a vote is.

texts.title: An Old Grudge Moves a Motion
texts.body: There is a motion before the Senate against your house, and it is {rival.name} of {rival.house} who moved it. Nobody in the chamber is surprised. They have held a grudge against your house since the chamber last saw them come off worse against you, and they have been waiting.

choices.answer_them_on_the_floor: Answer them on the floor, and name the old quarrel.
choices.make_your_peace: Go to them and make your peace. It will not stop this vote.

texts.title: The Senate's Act Falls on a Friend
texts.body: The Act has carried, and it falls hard on {friend.house}. {friend.name} voted against it to the last, and has written to you: not to complain, they say, but because a friend should hear it from them first. They would like to know what you mean to do. An Act is undone as it was made: by another Act, moved in the Senate.

choices.promise_the_repeal: Promise to move its repeal when the chamber will hear it.
choices.help_them_through: Send them help to carry it through the year, and ask nothing.
choices.the_law_is_the_law: Tell them the law is the law, for your house as for theirs.

texts.title: A Purse on the Senate Floor
texts.body: On the floor today it came out that you paid {bought.house} for its vote. The vote is struck, and the chamber thinks the less of your house. {bought.name} is the one who had to walk out past everyone, and is waiting to hear what you will say.

choices.take_it_on_yourself: Say before the chamber that it was your doing, not theirs.
choices.make_it_good: Pay them for what it has cost them.

texts.title: One of Yours Stands for Office
texts.body: {kin.name} has put their name down for office at the coming count. They have not asked your leave, and they do not need it: it is their name. The house can speak for them at the count, or pay for a canvass, as it can for anyone of the house who stands. What they have come to ask is what you will do yourself.

choices.walk_the_wards: Walk the wards with them, so the city sees the house behind them.
choices.teach_them_the_floor: Teach them how a crowd is won.
choices.let_them_win_it: Tell them an office is won by the one who stands.

texts.title: A Smear After the Election
texts.body: {accuser.name} of {accuser.house} lost at the count to one of your house, and is saying in every square that the count was bought. It was not, or not more than any count is. But it is being said, and the squares like to hear it.

choices.open_the_accounts: Open the house's accounts to the praetors.
choices.answer_in_kind: Pay a pamphleteer to say what is known of their own canvass.

texts.title: The Pamphlet Scandal
texts.body: Your pamphleteer and the one {accuser.name} of {accuser.house} pays have been at it all year. The squares have enjoyed it. Nobody believes either side, which is to say that both houses are now believed to have bought their counts. {accuser.name} has sent word that they will stop if you will.

choices.before_a_praetor: Have their pamphlets brought before a praetor.

texts.title: The One Who Won the Office
texts.body: {victor.name} of {victor.house} took the office one of your house stood for. The count is posted on the Senate doors. Your people want to know whether the house will ask for it to be read again.

choices.congratulate_them: Go and congratulate them where the city can see.
choices.demand_a_recount: Demand the count be read again.

texts.title: A Riot on the Day of the Count
texts.body: The squares do not believe the magistrates this year, and they did not believe the count. By noon there were stones at the booths and a crowd at the Senate doors, and the lictors have sent to every house to ask what it will do.

choices.keep_the_peace: Send your house's people to keep the peace at the booths.
choices.speak_from_the_steps: Speak to the crowd from the Senate steps.
choices.call_the_lictors: Tell the lictors to clear the squares.
choices.bar_the_doors: Bar your doors until it is over.

texts.title: The Consul-Elect's Feast
texts.body: The count is done, and {grandee.name} of {grandee.house} is Senior Consul for ten years: they will preside, speak from the chair, break a tied Senate and strike what they like with a veto. Tonight they dine the Senate. Everyone who means to have anything of the consuls in those ten years will be at that table, and everyone will see who is not.

choices.go_and_be_seen: Go, and be seen to go.
choices.send_a_gift_ahead: Send a gift ahead of you that the table will talk about.
choices.ask_for_your_bench: Go, and ask across the table what the consulship will do for your bench.

texts.title: Your Colleague, the Consul
texts.body: You and {grandee.name} of {grandee.house} hold the two chairs of the consulship. Each of you can strike the other's business with a veto, and the chamber is waiting to see which of you will try it first. {grandee.name} has asked to see you before the first session.

choices.divide_the_year: Divide the year's business between you.
choices.the_senior_chair_leads: Tell them the senior chair leads.
choices.keep_your_counsel: Keep your own counsel, and watch them.
